spec.description: Zeigt die aktuell gemeldete Fahrzeuglast direkt aus dem Live-Sensorstrom.
spec.title: Fahrzeuglast aktuell

spec.query:
from(bucket: "MKP")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "adxl345" and r._field =~ /^(vibration_rms|vibration_z_rms)$/ and r.device == "bridge01")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "MKP")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ads1220" and r._field == "strain_mm_m_avg" and r.device == "bridge01")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "MKP")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "adxl345" and r._field =~ /^(roll_deg_avg|pitch_deg_avg)$/ and r.device == "bridge01")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
